articles.title: Nvidia’s humiliated board should resign out of embarrassment | Nils Pratley
articles.snippet: Jensen Huang’s return as CEO comes despite fact board hasn’t completed investigation into reports of affair with alleged Chinese spy Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO Business live – latest updates What was it that Nvidia’s board was saying about there being no chance of Jensen Huang coming back? The position – a mere six days ago – was supposed to be definitive. The exit of the co-founder came after “disclosure of personal behaviour inconsistent with the company’s code of conduct, standards and cultural norms”, said Harvey Jones, who had been rapidly installed as chair of the chipmaker. The board “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO” after he “voluntarily resigned,” added Jones .

articles.snippet: De politie van de zone Kouter houdt de komende weken extra controles in familiepark Klein Strand in Jabbeke. articles.snippet: Tijdens de nationale betoging in Brussel voeren ook Gentse dokters actie.
